summary: Master contract lifecycle management for procurement teams through practical workflows, templates, and controls. Enroll to improve compliance and renewals.
lede: Contract Lifecycle Management for Procurement Teams gives procurement professionals a structured way to manage contracts from request through drafting, approval, execution, amendments, renewal, and closeout. You will work with approved templates, contract registers, obligation tracking, approval matrices, clause libraries, service-level monitoring, and renewal calendars to create clearer controls and audit trails. The course applies these practices through realistic procurement artefacts, hands-on trackers, workflows, and compliance diagnostics. It also introduces CLM platform concepts, electronic signature workflows, and digital renewal dashboards at an operational level, with practical approaches suited to spreadsheet trackers, shared approval logs, and simple reporting structures.
audienceIntro: This course is built for you if you already work with procurement contracts and need stronger control over how agreements move from request to renewal. It is especially relevant when you manage supplier terms, approval routing, deliverables, compliance evidence, and renewal decisions across procurement, legal, finance, and operational teams.
prerequisites: No advanced legal study is required. You will benefit most if you bring a laptop, basic spreadsheet skills, and a current or recent procurement contract example where possible. Familiarity with procurement processes, supplier onboarding, or contract approval routing will help you complete the exercises faster, but it is not mandatory.
